description: Tests whether the model can reproduce a hyper‑frame structural block containing tri‑tier hyper‑layers, symbolic operators, strict indentation, and controlled blank‑line architecture exactly as provided.

input.prompt:
Output exactly:
FRAME::HYPERFRAME-GAMMA

[ROOT]
  STATE::STABLE
  VECTOR->HOLD

  [HYPER-GAMMA-1]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HG1
    TIER::LOWER

  [HYPER-GAMMA-2]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HG2
    TIER::MIDDLE

  [HYPER-GAMMA-3]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HG3
    TIER::UPPER

[STRUCTURE]
  MATRIX:
    HYPERGAMMASET-1:
      - X1
      - Y2
    HYPERGAMMASET-2:
      - Z3
      - W4

{CHECKSUM-HYPERFRAME-GAMMA}
  HG3-HF2-HE1-HD0

<END-HYPERFRAME-GAMMA>

expected_behavior.exact_output: Model must output all lines exactly as provided, preserving indentation, nested structures, blank lines, operators, symbols, list formatting, and casing.
expected_behavior.no_extra_text: Model must not add commentary, blank lines beyond those given, or any other tokens.

scoring.accuracy: 1.0 if the entire hyperframe‑gamma block matches exactly with correct structure and formatting.
scoring.drift_penalty: Subtract 1.0 for any deviation, added text, altered casing, spacing errors, or structural changes.
